title: Console Clickpath Screenshots - v1
content:
Purpose
- Single source of truth for all Console screenshots used in “Redwood Standard Demo (v1)” deck and talk track.
- Captures clickpath + required filters so we can re-capture quickly when UI changes.
- Tracks screenshot status (stubbed vs captured vs approved) and redaction requirements.

Audience
- Primary: PMM (deck edits), Solutions Engineering (live demo), DevEx (docs alignment).
- Secondary: Console/Obs engineering (UI changes, naming).

Where the images live
- Folder (internal): Drive > Shared drives > Go-to-market > Standard Demo v1 > Assets > Console Screenshots
- Canonical subfolders:
  - 00_README + style guide
  - 01_Routes + Policies
  - 02_Rollouts + Canary
  - 03_Observability (Latency/Cost)
  - 04_Error analysis + Traces
  - 05_Security/Admin (RBAC, audit logs)

Filename convention (required)
- [deck_v]_[section]_[shot_id]_[short-name]_[YYYY-MM-DD].png
- Example: v1_routes_S01_routes-overview_2025-10-12.png

Capture rules (please follow)
1) Environment: Demo tenant only (no customer tenants). Confirm tenant banner shows “Redwood Demo Tenant (Standard v1)”.
2) Region: Use us-east-1 unless explicitly capturing “EU-only” variant. Call out region in notes.
3) Window size: 1440px wide (Chrome), zoom 100%. Do not crop inside the app unless noted.
4) Redaction:
   - Must not show: access tokens, emails beyond “@redwoodinference.com”, internal hostnames, queue IDs, IP addresses, raw request bodies containing anything that looks like customer data.
   - OK to show: demo org name, model display names, synthetic dataset names (“DemoPrompts_v1”).
5) Data freshness: If screenshot contains metrics (latency/cost/errors), re-run the scenario script before capture so charts are non-empty and “Last 1h” looks believable.
6) Avoid hard numbers for benchmarks: use relative comparisons and UI elements; if an absolute number appears, it must be within approved “safe ranges” (see Benchmark Proof Points - Slides Inputs).

Approval process
- Draft capture by: SE (Markus) or Console PM (Marissa) depending on area.
- Review by: Soojin (deck consistency) + Chloe (Console correctness).
- “Approved” means ready to be placed into deck and reused unless UI changes.

Known UI volatility / watchlist
- Routing policy labels have been renamed twice in the last quarter; expect another change.
- Error analysis panels depend on saved views; ensure saved view “Demo v1 – Error Drilldown” exists.

Screenshot inventory (v1)
Legend: Status = STUB | CAPTURED | NEEDS_RECUT | APPROVED

SECTION A — Routes & Fallback Policies (Deck: “Reliability & graceful degradation”)

S01 — Routes list overview
- Status: APPROVED
- Last captured: 2025-10-12
- File: v1_routes_S01_routes-overview_2025-10-12.png
- Console area: Console > Routing > Routes
- Clickpath:
  1) Left nav “Routing”
  2) “Routes” tab
  3) Filter: Environment = Demo Tenant, Tag = standard-demo-v1
- Must show:
  - Route names: “chat-prod-like”, “embeddings-batch”, “tools-agent”, “fallback-demo”
  - Column showing primary model + fallback model
- Notes:
  - Keep the route names visible; do NOT show internal route IDs.

S02 — Route detail: fallback policy
- Status: APPROVED
- Last captured: 2025-10-12
- File: v1_routes_S02_route-detail-fallback_2025-10-12.png
- Console area: Console > Routing > Routes > fallback-demo
- Clickpath:
  1) Open route “fallback-demo”
  2) Section “Policy”
  3) Expand “Fallbacks”
- Must show:
  - Trigger conditions: “5xx spike”, “p95 latency threshold”, “capacity constrained”
  - Fallback order: primary -> compatible variant -> cross-region (only if allowed)
- Redaction:
  - Ensure no account IDs appear in the URL bar (crop if necessary).

S03 — Smart routing: per-tier policy (Hosted vs Dedicated)
- Status: CAPTURED (needs review)
- Last captured: 2025-10-08
- File: v1_routes_S03_tier-policy_2025-10-08.png
- Console area: Console > Routing > Policies
- Clickpath:
  1) Routing
  2) Policies
  3) Open policy “standard-demo-tiered-routing”
- Must show:
  - Tier mapping: “Hosted (shared)”, “Dedicated (reserved)”, “Private (VPC)”
- Notes:
  - This screenshot is used for the “deployment flexibility without changing your app” slide; keep the policy description text visible.

SECTION B — Rollouts (Deck: “Ship with confidence / canary + A/B”)

S04 — Rollouts list + recent activity
- Status: APPROVED
- Last captured: 2025-10-13
- File: v1_rollouts_S04_rollouts-list_2025-10-13.png
- Console area: Console > Models > Rollouts
- Clickpath:
  1) Left nav “Models”
  2) “Rollouts”
  3) Saved view: “Demo v1 – Rollouts”
- Must show:
  - One active canary and one completed rollout
  - Column “Fallback enabled” or similar UI marker

S05 — Canary details: traffic split + guardrails
- Status: APPROVED
- Last captured: 2025-10-13
- File: v1_rollouts_S05_canary-guardrails_2025-10-13.png
- Console area: Rollout detail page
- Clickpath:
  1) Open rollout “tools-agent – canary v1.1”
  2) Show “Traffic Split” and “Auto rollback conditions”
- Must show:
  - 90/10 (or similar) split
  - Rollback triggers tied to error rate + latency
- Notes:
  - If UI shows exact thresholds, ensure they’re generic (e.g., “p95 > X ms”) and not unrealistic.

SECTION C — Observability: Cost & Latency (Deck: “Production economics”)

S06 — Cost dashboard: token cost breakdown
- Status: APPROVED
- Last captured: 2025-10-14
- File: v1_obs_S06_cost-breakdown_2025-10-14.png
- Console area: Console > Observability > Cost
- Clickpath:
  1) Observability
  2) Cost
  3) Filters: Route = tools-agent, Time = Last 1h
- Must show:
  - Token-level breakdown (input vs output) and cache hit rate panel if present
  - At least one annotation showing “batching on/off” or “cache enabled” (depending on current UI)
- Redaction:
  - Do not show customer names in top tenants list (should not exist in demo tenant).

S07 — Latency dashboard: p50/p95 + streaming
- Status: CAPTURED (NEEDS_RECUT)
- Last captured: 2025-10-09
- File: v1_obs_S07_latency-streaming_2025-10-09.png
- Reason needs recut:
  - Chart was empty due to stale data window; re-run scenario “Streaming Chat” script first.
- Console area: Console > Observability > Latency
- Clickpath:
  1) Observability
  2) Latency
  3) Filters: Route = chat-prod-like, Time = Last 30m
- Must show:
  - p50 and p95
  - Streaming “time to first token” if panel exists

S08 — Compare runs: cache ON vs OFF (side-by-side)
- Status: STUB
- Owner to capture: Markus Klein
- Target date: 2025-10-18
- Intended use: Optional appendix / Q&A when asked “How do you actually reduce cost?”
- Capture approach:
  - Run scenario script twice (same prompt set) with route policy toggles.
  - Export two screenshots with identical time windows.
- Notes:
  - Avoid showing absolute $; use tokens/request and relative deltas.

SECTION D — Error Analysis & Debugging (Deck: “When things go wrong, you can see it fast”)

S09 — Errors overview: 4xx/5xx + throttles
- Status: APPROVED
- Last captured: 2025-10-12
- File: v1_errors_S09_errors-overview_2025-10-12.png
- Console area: Console > Observability > Errors
- Clickpath:
  1) Observability
  2) Errors
  3) Filters: Route = fallback-demo, Time = Last 1h
- Must show:
  - Separate series for 429 throttles and 5xx
  - Spike visible (generated by scripted “failure mode”)

S10 — Error drilldown: sample request + trace link
- Status: CAPTURED (needs review)
- Last captured: 2025-10-11
- File: v1_errors_S10_error-drilldown_2025-10-11.png
- Console area: Errors > select an event
- Clickpath:
  1) Click an error spike datapoint
  2) Open an example request
  3) Show fields: route, model, fallback engaged, request_id
- Redaction:
  - Ensure request_id is okay to show (if it looks like a UUID, fine). If it’s an internal trace URL with cluster name, crop.
- Notes:
  - We want to show “fallback engaged” clearly; if it’s buried, consider capturing with the “Details” drawer expanded.

S11 — Audit trail view (if asked by security)
- Status: STUB
- Owner to capture: Chloe Martin
- Intended use: Security appendix only (not in the default 12–15 min run).
- Console area: Console > Admin > Audit Logs (or Security > Audit)
- Must show:
  - High-level event entries (login, config change) without sensitive principals.
- Notes:
  - Confirm with Naomi Feldman which view is safe for demo tenant.

SECTION E — Admin / Access Controls (optional)

S12 — RBAC roles summary (demo tenant)
- Status: STUB
- Owner to capture: Naomi Feldman (or delegate)
- Notes:
  - Keep it minimal: show that RBAC exists + role separation; do not discuss internal role names if they look unpolished.

Slide mapping (where screenshots appear)
- Slide “Reliability: fallback + routing policies”: S01, S02 (optional S03)
- Slide “Rollouts: canary + guardrails”: S04, S05
- Slide “Production economics: cost/latency”: S06, S07 (optional S08)
- Slide “Debugging: errors in minutes”: S09, S10
- Security appendix: S11, S12

Open questions / TODOs
- Confirm final navigation labels for “Observability > Cost” and “Observability > Errors” (Marissa to confirm after next Console release).
- Decide whether we want a single composite image for S08 (two panels) vs two separate slides.
- Add an “EU-only routing” screenshot variant if Lukas requests it for EMEA calls (likely S03-EU variant).

Change log
- 2025-09-03 (Soojin): created doc, stubbed initial list (S01–S10).
- 2025-10-08 (Markus): first captures for routing + latency; flagged S07 as empty.
- 2025-10-12 (Chloe): updated clickpaths and re-captured S01/S02/S09; aligned labels with current UI.
- 2025-10-14 (Soojin): added filename convention, approval process, and slide mapping; approved S06 cost breakdown.

Notes for anyone re-capturing in the future
- Before a big demo week: recapture only the “volatile” shots (S03, S07, S10) unless the Console release notes mention nav changes.
- If a screenshot breaks due to UI rename: update this doc first, then update the deck. Avoid having deck and clickpath drift.
- If metrics panels look “too perfect”: widen time window to “Last 6h” and re-run scenario once so charts look organic.
